events.title: Universal Music Shares Slide on Weak Revenue, Earnings

events.title: Universal Music to sell half its Spotify stake, boosts buyback
events.body: Investing.com -- Universal Music Group NV said Wednesday it will sell half of its stake in Spotify Technology SA and increase its share buyback program to €1 billion.

events.body: The Pershing Square chief aims to end UMG's "languishing" stock price by seeking eligibility for major US indexes like the S&P 500.
